mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and driving positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 8.0% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which triggers risk-off behavior and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 8.0% for 3 months, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and personal consumption (RSAFS) signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.03) or SPX returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real output, which signals economic slowdown and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during INDPRO < 95.0 periods (t-test p > 0.05) or the signal's Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in residential construction (HOUST) above 600.0 thousand units, combined with a rising GDP growth rate (GDPC1), signals a recovery in housing demand and broader economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST > 600.0 and GDPC1 growth > 0.5% YoY (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% year-over-year, combined with a low federal funds rate, signals that the Fed may be behind the curve, increasing expectations of future rate hikes and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY and FEDFUNDS < 1.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) below 50,000 jobs per month, combined with a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE), indicates labor market weakening, which reduces consumer spending confidence and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when PAYEMS < 50.0 and UNRATE > 8.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in personal consumption (RSAFS) above 340 billion dollars, coupled with rising industrial production (INDPRO), signals strong aggregate demand and economic momentum, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when RSAFS > 340.0 and INDPRO > 97.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction signal's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.
